messages:
maria.prod: Heads-up — we need final sign-off on the split key schema + migration plan for scoped service tokens. Ops asked for launch criteria before we schedule the Dedicated rollout.

samir.sec: Can you paste the high-level migration steps? I want to validate revocation/rotation behavior.

maria.prod: TL;DR: introduce new token format `sk:{org}:{proj}:{id}` and a mapping table for legacy keys. Migration phases: 1) accept legacy keys + new keys (dual-read), 2) write new keys for new tokens, 3) backfill mapping for active legacy keys, 4) disable legacy issuance, 5) optional legacy-to-new rotation job.

josh-security: Important: during dual-read we must ensure legacy tokens can't be used to escalate project boundaries. Acceptance criteria: token lookup always checks project scoping, and if mapping exists we validate both. No silent fallback that widens scope.

anya.pm: From product POV we need clear rollout gating: QA sign-off on regression tests, telemetry showing <0.1% auth error increase across orgs, console UX for creating scoped tokens, and docs + SDK changes.

lee-sre: For canary rollout propose: 5% of requests routed to new auth service (read-only mode) for 48 hours, then 25% for 24 hours, verify metrics, then enable write path. Also need a fast kill switch and a fallback to legacy auth.

samir.sec: Edge cases to capture in the PRD: orphaned mapping rows (deleted projects), tokens tied to deleted users, cross-org token reuse attempts, and replayed tokens after rotation. Add acceptance tests for each.

maria.prod: Noted. Draft acceptance checklist I'm proposing:
- Unit+integration tests for token parser + scope enforcement.
- End-to-end test simulating legacy->new rotation on live-like data.
- Load test at peak QPS with new token format and mapping table latency under 15ms p50.
- Audit log entries for every token validation (include org/proj/id).
- Migration dry-run with sample of 10 orgs and rollback validation.

josh-security: Also require KMS keyproof for token signing in Private deployments. Add config flags so Private can point to HSM/KMS without changing code paths.

anya.pm: UX acceptance: console should show token scope chips, a warning if token crosses multiple projects, and a one-click rotate that schedules rotation job. Docs should include migration FAQ for self-hosted customers.

lee-sre: Observability: dashboards for 1) token validation latency, 2) auth error rate by org, 3) migration job progress, 4) token revocation lag. Alerts: auth-error-rate > 0.5% for 15m -> rollback.

maria.prod: Good. Open questions: do we forbid legacy tokens entirely after cutoff or keep them as emergency fallback for 30 days? Ops leans keep fallback but gated. Thoughts?

samir.sec: Security prefers hard cutoff after a short grace window. If ops needs fallback, ensure it's movable behind an emergency feature-flag (off by default) and requires an audit ticket to re-enable.

josh-security: Agree with samir. If fallback exists it must not bypass scope checks and must be auditable.

anya.pm: Let's set policy: 7-day fallback window post-cutoff, fallback disabled by default in Dedicated and Private. That gives customers time to rotate. We can extend per-customer on request.

maria.prod: I'll update the PRD with those launch criteria and the migration runbook. Action items:
- maria.prod: update PRD + rollout plan by EOD Fri.
- josh-security/samir.sec: draft acceptance test matrix and security checklist.
- lee-sre: stub dashboards + alert rules, propose canary traffic schedule.
- anya.pm: update console mockups and docs outline.

release-bot: Reminder: create rollout epic in Jira (INF-3120) and link PRD doc.

maria.prod: Thanks everyone, ping me in-thread if anything else to add. :+1:
